blocks.html: Robinsons Homes is one of the country's leading residential property developers with numerous projects in key urbanized cities nationwide, spanning the north of the Philippines; from Laoag City down South in General Santos. In Western Visayas, particularly in Bacolod City, popularly known as the City of Smiles is where Robinsons Homes’ newest residential address is located. Brighton Bacolod located in Brgy. Estefania, Bacolod City, is at the heart of one of the cleanest and greenest urbanized cities in the country. It is strategically located near to the city’s key business districts, established institutions such as the University of St. La Salle and the Bacolod Government Center, lifestyle and tourist destinations, numerous golf and country clubs and Robinson's Place Bacolod. In Brighton Bacolod, future residents can take a pick from 735 choice residential lots with a predominant cut of 180 sqm. “Brighton Bacolod is a themed development showcasing Contemporary Mediterranean architecture styled homes, complemented by lifestyle amenities and facilities that the entire family can enjoy”, shares Ms. Cora Ang Ley, General Manager, Robinsons Homes. Ms. Ang Ley adds that the village clubhouse, lends exclusivity to the residents’ lifestyle which includes celebrating their major milestone. A leisure pool, a park, and basketball court not only enhance family bonding but also promotes healthy living for its residents. “Our planners and architects have carefully laid out Brighton Bacolod to provide more privacy to its residents,” says Ms. Ang Ley. Hence only 33 houses have been allocated per hectare in this residential development. In addition, a perimeter fence surrounding the entire enclave, and two guarded entrances in the North and South gates, have been constructed to secure the entire property. Robinsons Homes is one of the four brands of Robinsons Land Corporation’s residential division, taking pride in building enduring addresses that nurture early nesters to growing families who aspire to start the good life in their first home or upgrade to a bigger and better abode. Staying true to its cornerstone of quality and value, Robinsons Homes offers choice residential lots in master planned subdivisions in key urbanized cities and provinces nationwide. Homebuyers may select from themed enclaves under the Bloomfields, Brighton and Springdale sub-brands to suit their lifestyle and taste. Live amidst serene landscapes and create lasting memories with those you love the most. Start the good life in one of the gated Robinsons Homes neighborhood located in Laoag, Tarlac, Pampanga, Bulacan, Antipolo, Batangas, Cavite, Palawan, Bacolod, Cebu, Davao, Cagayan de Oro and General Santos.
